# Lobe Icons brand marks

The inline monochrome Codex, OpenRouter and Anthropic paths in
`src/provider-icons.ts` come from `@lobehub/icons-static-svg` version 1.101.0.
They are included at build time; cards make no remote icon requests.

- Project: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
- Codex: https://unpkg.com/@lobehub/icons-static-svg@1.101.0/icons/codex.svg
- OpenRouter: https://unpkg.com/@lobehub/icons-static-svg@1.101.0/icons/openrouter.svg
- Anthropic: https://unpkg.com/@lobehub/icons-static-svg@1.101.0/icons/anthropic.svg
- License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 LobeHub

The brand names and marks remain the property of their respective owners.
